(1) we propose a novel framework for jointly learning explainable rules for recommendation and a rule guided neural model; (2) the framework encourages the two modules to complement and reinforce each other; (3) the proposed model can achieve better generalization ability in dealing with the cold-start issue and outperforms baselines in item recommendation.
We propose a joint learning framework to incorporate item association rules mined from knowledge graphs to enhance neural recommendation models.
1) our proposed framework can generate explainable rules and recommendation model jointly; 2) our model is robust to noisy knowledge graph.

the problem of jointly learning explainable rules for item recommendation from knowledge graphs and has the following contributions: 1) we present a novel framework for jointly learning rules and neural recommendation model from item knowledge graphs, which can provide explainable recommendation results; 2) our method is the first to integrate the symbolic and neural recommendation approaches and can effectively handle the cold start issue by incorporating induced rules.
